results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.3, Reception of an RRCReconfiguration by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall release VarConditionalReconfig.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5.3 (Reception of an RRCReconfiguration), conditional reconfiguration execution: if the RRCReconfiguration is applied due to conditional reconfiguration execution upon cell selection while T311 was running, the UE shall release VarConditionalReconfig.

results.question: To which RRC state can the network transit a UE from RRC_CONNECTED using the RRC connection release procedure?
results.reference: to transit a UE in RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.2, Initiation
results.model_answer: RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5 (RRC connection release): the network uses RRCRelease to transition a UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE.

results.question: Under what condition does the UE indicate the release of the DRB and the eps-BearerIdentity of the released DRB to upper layers?
results.reference: if a new bearer is not added either with NR or E-UTRA with same eps-BearerIdentity
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.4, DRB release
results.model_answer: The UE does so if the DRB being released is associated with an eps-BearerIdentity.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5.3 (actions on reception of RRCReconfiguration): "if the DRB is associated with an eps-BearerIdentity, indicate the release of the DRB and the eps-BearerIdentity of the released DRB to upper layers."

results.question: Under what condition can the network initiate the RRC connection release procedure to transit a UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_INACTIVE?
results.reference: only if SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB or, for IAB, SRB2, is setup in RRC_CONNECTED
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.2, Initiation
results.model_answer: The network may initiate the RRC connection release procedure while the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED, to transition it to RRC_INACTIVE.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.8.1 (RRC connection release — General): "The network may initiate the RRC connection release procedure to transit a UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE."

results.question: What is the purpose of the RRC connection resume procedure?
results.reference: to resume a suspended RRC connection, including resuming SRB(s), DRB(s) and multicast MRB(s) or perform an RNA update
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13.1, General
results.model_answer: To resume a suspended RRC connection.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.13.1 (RRC resume – General): the RRC resume procedure is used to resume a suspended RRC connection.

results.question: For an existing multicast MRB, if the recoverPDCP is set, what does the UE trigger?
results.reference: trigger the PDCP entity of this MRB to perform data recovery as specified in TS 38.323 ;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.7, Multicast MRB addition/modification
results.model_answer: The UE triggers the PDCP data recovery procedure for that MRB, as specified in TS 38.323.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5.3 (Reception of an RRCReconfiguration by the UE), MRB processing: for an existing MRB, if recoverPDCP is set, the UE shall trigger the PDCP data recovery procedure for the MRB.

results.question: Besides state transitions, what other action can the RRC connection release procedure be used for?
results.reference: to release and redirect a UE to another frequency
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.8.2, Initiation
results.model_answer: It can be used to redirect the UE to an inter-RAT frequency.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.8.1 (RRC connection release — General): "The RRC connection release procedure is used to transition a UE from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE and can be used to redirect a UE to an inter-RAT frequency."

results.question: What does the UE do if the SDAP entity associated with a DRB to be released is configured?
results.reference: indicate the release of the DRB to SDAP entity associated with this DRB (TS 37.324 , clause 5.3.3)
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.4, DRB release
results.model_answer: The UE releases the SDAP entity associated with the DRB.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5.3 (DRB addition/modification/release): "if the SDAP entity associated with a DRB to be released is configured, the UE shall release the SDAP entity associated with the DRB."

results.question: How does the UE treat a drb-ToReleaseList that includes any drb-Identity value not part of the current UE configuration?
results.reference: The UE does not consider the message as erroneous
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.6.4, DRB release
results.model_answer: The UE ignores each drb-Identity in drb-ToReleaseList that is not part of the current UE configuration.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 6.3.2 (RadioBearerConfig): the UE shall ignore any DRB identity included in drb-ToReleaseList that is not part of the current UE configuration.

results.question: Under what RRC states shall the UE apply the procedures for essential system information missing?
results.reference: if in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE  or  in RRC_CONNECTED   while T311 is running:
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.5, Essential system information missing
results.model_answer: RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE, and RRC_CONNECTED.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.2.2 (System information acquisition), procedure/subclause "Essential SI missing": the UE applies the procedure when it determines that essential SI is missing in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE, or RRC_CONNECTED.

results.question: What action does the UE take if inter-RAT cell selection or reselection occurs while T331 is running?
results.reference: stop timer T331; perform the actions as specified in 5.7.8.3
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.8.4, Cell re-selection or cell selection while T331 is running
results.model_answer: The UE shall stop T331.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.3 (RRC_IDLE cell selection/reselection procedures; T331 handling for inter-RAT cell selection or reselection).

results.question: Which system information block type's reception actions are referenced for SIB13?
results.reference: SystemInformationBlockType21
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.14, Actions upon reception of SIB13
results.model_answer: SIB1 (SystemInformationBlockType1).
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.2.2.3 (Acquisition of SIB1): the SIB13-related procedure references the actions specified for reception of SIB1.

results.question: Upon reception of SIB13, what procedure shall the UE follow?
results.reference: perform the actions upon reception of SystemInformationBlockType21 as specified in 5.2.2.28 in TS 36.331
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.14, Actions upon reception of SIB13
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform the MBS broadcast reception procedure.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.2.2 (System information acquisition), SIB13 reception handling: upon reception of SIB13, the UE performs the MBS broadcast reception procedure.

results.question: What does the UE indicate when it has uplink data to transmit for a DRB without an MCG RLC bearer while the SCG is deactivated?
results.reference: indicate that the UE has uplink data to transmit for a DRB for which there is no MCG RLC bearer while the SCG is deactivated
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.4.1, General RRCReconfiguration UEAssistanceInformation
results.model_answer: The UE indicates an SCG activation request to the MCG/network.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.7.4 (SCG activation/deactivation): UE behaviour for uplink data on a DRB that has no MCG RLC bearer while the SCG is deactivated includes indicating an SCG activation request.

results.question: From which entity is NAS dedicated information transferred in the General ULInformationTransfer procedure?
results.reference: from the UE
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.1, General ULInformationTransfer
results.model_answer: UE
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.3 (ULInformationTransfer): the procedure is used to transfer NAS dedicated information from the UE to the network.

results.question: If a UE in RRC_CONNECTED receives an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink, what procedure shall it perform?
results.reference: perform the sidelink UE information for NR sidelink communication procedure, as specified in 5.8.3.3 or clause 5.10.15 in TS 36.331
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.1.8, Reception of an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink by the UE
results.model_answer: It shall initiate the Sidelink UE Information procedure.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.10 (Sidelink), subclause "Reception of an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink by the UE": for a UE in RRC_CONNECTED, receipt of RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink triggers initiation of the Sidelink UE Information procedure.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Notification message in RRC?
results.reference: to inform UEs in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE about system information changes and ETWS/CMAS indications
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.10, Notification Message
results.model_answer: It notifies a UE of a change in system information.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 6.2.2 (Notification): “The purpose of this message is to notify the UE about a change of system information.”

results.question: Upon reception of which SIB does the UE perform actions specified in TS 38.304 for slicing priorities?
results.reference: SIB16
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.18, Actions upon reception of SIB16
results.model_answer: SIB1 (SystemInformationBlockType1).
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.2.1 (SIB1): upon reception of SIB1, the UE performs the applicable actions specified in TS 38.304, including those related to slicing priorities.

results.question: Which procedure does the UE initiate if it is a L2 U2N Remote UE and in RRC_CONNECTED upon detecting sidelink radio link failure?
results.reference: initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.model_answer: The UE initiates the RRC re-establishment procedure.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.11 (Sidelink radio link failure): upon detecting sidelink RLF, an L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED initiates the RRC re-establishment procedure.

results.question: What does the UE do with the NR sidelink communication related configuration of the destination upon detecting sidelink radio link failure?
results.reference: discard the NR sidelink communication related configuration of this destination
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.model_answer: The UE releases the NR sidelink communication-related configuration associated with that destination.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.8.11, "Sidelink radio link failure" (UE actions upon detection of sidelink RLF).

results.question: What shall the UE do with the nas-SecurityParamFromNR when targetRAT-Type is set to eutra?
results.reference: forward the nas-SecurityParamFromNR to the upper layers, if included
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.3.3, Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall forward nas-SecurityParamFromNR to E-UTRA.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5.3 (Reception of an RRCReconfiguration by the UE): when targetRAT-Type is set to eutra, the UE forwards nas-SecurityParamFromNR to E-UTRA.

results.question: How are actual transmitted SSBs sequentially numbered?
results.reference: from one in ascending order of their SSB indexes
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.2, Acquisition of an SI message
results.model_answer: Actual transmitted SSBs are numbered sequentially starting at 0, in ascending order of their occurrence in time within the half-frame (SS burst).
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.4.3.1 (SSB positions / SSB-PositionsInBurst); see also TS 38.213, clause 4.1 for SS/PBCH block indexing.

results.question: What shall the UE do if the nas-Container is included in the received masterKeyUpdate?
results.reference: forward the nas-Container to the upper layers
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.7, AS Security key update
results.model_answer: The UE shall deliver the nas-Container to upper layers.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5.3, "Reception of an RRCReconfiguration by the UE" (masterKeyUpdate handling).

results.question: What does the UE set sl-TxInterestedFreqList to indicate for NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission?
results.reference: set sl-TxInterestedFreqList to indicate the frequency of the associated destination for NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.model_answer: The UE sets sl-TxInterestedFreqList to indicate the NR sidelink frequency/frequencies on which it is interested in transmitting for NR sidelink communication using an L3 U2N relay UE.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, Sidelink UE information procedure / SidelinkUEInformationNR IE semantics for sl-TxInterestedFreqList (most likely §5.10.3 and the corresponding §6.2.2 IE definition).

results.question: What does the [xN+K]th PDCCH monitoring occasion for SI message in SI-window correspond to?
results.reference: the Kth transmitted SSB
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.2, Acquisition of an SI message
results.model_answer: It corresponds to the Kth PDCCH monitoring occasion in the xth SI-window, where N is the number of PDCCH monitoring occasions per SI-window.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.2.1 (Acquisition of SI): the [xN+K]th PDCCH monitoring occasion for an SI message corresponds to the Kth PDCCH monitoring occasion in the xth SI-window.

results.question: Under what condition does the UE include the mobilityState in the RRCSetupComplete message when the RRCSetup is received in response to an RRCSetupRequest?
results.reference: if speedStateReselectionPars is configured in the SIB2
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.3.4, Reception of the RRCSetup by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE includes mobilityState when it is in medium or high mobility state (i.e., not in normal mobility state).
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.3.4 (Actions following reception of RRCSetup): for an RRCSetup received in response to an RRCSetupRequest, the UE includes mobilityState if it is in medium or high mobility state.

results.question: What does the UE set ue-Type to if it is acting as an NR sidelink L3 U2N Relay UE?
results.reference: set it to relayUE
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.model_answer: relayUE
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.10.3 (Sidelink UE information): the UE sets ue-Type to relayUE when acting as an NR sidelink L3 U2N Relay UE.

results.question: Under what condition related to barring does the UE initiate RRC connection resume with resumeCause rna-Update when pendingRNA-Update is true?
results.reference: if barring is alleviated for Access Category '8' or Access Category '2'
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.13.8, RNA update
results.model_answer: The UE initiates RRC connection resume with resumeCause set to rna-Update only when it is not barred from accessing the cell (while pendingRNA-Update is true).
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.13.1 (RRC connection resume — General): the RNA-update-triggered resume is performed when pendingRNA-Update is true and the UE is not barred; resumeCause is set to rna-Update.

results.question: Under what intra-RAT condition while T331 is running does the UE stop T331 and perform actions in 5.7.8.3?
results.reference: if the serving frequency matches with the carrierFreq of an entry in the validityAreaList, the validityCellList is included in that entry, and the physical cell identity of the serving cell does not match with any entry in validityCellList
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.8.4, Cell re-selection or cell selection while T331 is running
results.model_answer: When the UE reselects to an intra-RAT cell that is not part of the configured RAN Notification Area (RNA).
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.7.8 (RRC_INACTIVE mobility/RNA handling): if T331 is running and the UE reselects an intra-RAT cell outside the configured RNA, it stops T331 and performs the actions specified in clause 5.7.8.3.

results.question: How are PDCCH monitoring occasions determined for SI message acquisition when searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation is set to zero?
results.reference: PDCCH monitoring occasions for SI message reception in SI-window are same as PDCCH monitoring occasions for SIB1 where the mapping between PDCCH monitoring occasions and SSBs is specified in TS 38.213.
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.3.2, Acquisition of an SI message
results.model_answer: The UE uses SearchSpaceZero (Type0-PDCCH CSS). Its PDCCH monitoring occasions are derived from the CORESET0/SearchSpaceZero configuration indicated by MIB pdcch-ConfigSIB1, according to TS 38.213 clause 13.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.2.2.1 (SI acquisition procedure): handling of PDCCH monitoring for SI messages using searchSpaceOtherSystemInformation; for value 0, SearchSpaceZero applies. TS 38.213, clause 13 specifies Type0-PDCCH common-search-space monitoring occasions.

results.question: Upon what indication from sidelink PDCP entity does the UE consider sidelink radio link failure?
results.reference: upon integrity check failure indication from sidelink PDCP entity concerning SL-SRB2 or SL-SRB3 for a specific destination
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.9.3, Sidelink radio link failure related actions
results.model_answer: The UE considers sidelink radio link failure upon an indication from the sidelink PDCP entity that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause "Sidelink radio link failure" (within clause 5.8, Sidelink UE procedures): "The UE shall consider a sidelink radio link failure to be detected upon indication from the sidelink PDCP entity that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached."

results.question: What shall the UE do if the targetRAT-Type in the MobilityFromNRCommand is set to utra-fdd?
results.reference: consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards UTRA-FDD
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.4.3.3, Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform cell selection to UTRA FDD in accordance with TS 25.304.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5 (Mobility from NR): if targetRAT-Type is set to utra-fdd, the UE performs cell selection to UTRA FDD in accordance with TS 25.304.

results.question: To which entity is F1-C related information transferred via IAB-MT in RRC CONNECTED?
results.reference: to IAB Donor-CU
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.7.2.1, General ULInformationTransfer
results.model_answer: The IAB-donor-CU.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, IAB-MT procedures in RRC_CONNECTED (most likely clause 5.7): an IAB-MT transfers F1-C related information to the IAB-donor-CU.

results.question: What shall the UE do if this procedure was initiated due to reception of the sk-Counter (UE is in NE-DC, or NR-DC, or is configured with SN terminated bearer(s))?
results.reference: derive or update the secondary key (S-K or S-KeNB) based on the KgNB key and using the received sk- gNB Counter value, as specified in TS 33.501
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.7, AS Security key update
results.model_answer: The UE shall derive/update the S-KgNB using the received sk-Counter (and use it for the SN-terminated bearers, as applicable), in accordance with TS 33.501.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5.3 (RRCReconfiguration—actions upon reception): conditional handling of sk-Counter for a UE in NE-DC, NR-DC, or configured with SN-terminated bearer(s), requiring derivation of S-KgNB as specified in TS 33.501.

results.question: When shall the UE discard any stored segments for SIB17 upon cell (re-)selection?
results.reference: upon cell (re-) selection
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.19, Actions upon reception of SIB17
results.model_answer: The UE shall discard any stored SIB17 segments upon every cell (re-)selection.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.2.2 (System information acquisition) — SIB17 segment handling requirement.

results.question: What does the UE set sl-QoS-InfoList to include for NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission?
results.reference: set sl-QoS-InfoList to include QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated destination configured by the upper layer for the NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission;
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.8.3.3, Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
results.model_answer: The UE sets sl-QoS-InfoList to include the QoS information for each PC5 QoS flow associated with the NR sidelink L3 U2N relay communication transmission.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.7.1.2 (Sidelink UE information reporting), UE actions for reporting sl-QoS-InfoList.

results.question: What shall the UE do upon receiving SIB13?
results.reference: perform the actions upon reception of SystemInformationBlockType21 as specified in 5.2.2.28 in TS 36.331
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.2.2.4.14, Actions upon reception of SIB13
results.model_answer: The UE shall apply the sidelink common configuration carried in SIB13 for sidelink operation in the cell.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.2 (System information), in particular the SIB13-v1610 definition/handling for NR sidelink system information.

results.question: For which sl-L2Identity-Remote values in the sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList shall the L2 U2N Relay UE configure parameters to SRAP entity?
results.reference: for each sl-L2Identity-Remote value included in the sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList that is not part of the current UE configuration (L2 U2N Remote UE Addition)
results.gold_evidence: TS 38.331, Clause 5.3.5.15.2, L2 U2N Remote UE Release
results.model_answer: For each sl-L2Identity-Remote value included in the sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList.
results.evidence: 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.3.5.3 (Reception of RRCReconfiguration by the UE): for an L2 U2N Relay UE, the UE configures parameters to the SRAP entity for each sl-L2Identity-Remote value included in sl-RemoteUE-ToAddModList.
